title: GenerationRepairResponse
description: Parsed LLM output for llm.generation.repair: repaired candidate source from a prior candidate and compiler diagnostics.

prior_candidate_bytes.description: Base64-encoded bytes of the prior candidate being repaired.

diagnostics.description: Compiler diagnostics that triggered the repair.

recommended_repair_bytes.description: Base64-encoded bytes of the recommended repair snippet.

new_candidate_source_bytes.description: Base64-encoded source bytes for the new repaired candidate.

handoff_followups.description: Follow-up work items or capability IDs to hand off after repair.
